t: The Hep2O plastic push-fit reducing coupler provides a reliable and efficient solution for connecting 15mm to 10mm pipes within various water systems. This keyless plumbing fitting is ideal for domestic and commercial installations, including under-sink connections or radiator pipework modifications. Its tool-free push-fit system ensures a quick and secure connection, with In4Sure joint recognition confirming correct pipe insertion. The fitting is easily demountable and reusable by hand without a key, offering flexibility for future adjustments. It is suitable for drinking water and performs across a wide temperature range from 2°C to 114°C, accommodating both hard and soft water areas.
